reference.pathophysiology: Adenoma or hyperplasia oversecretes aldosterone retaining sodium while wasting potassium and hydrogen; chromaffin tumours dump catecholamines in paroxysms, and unblocked sympathetic surgery or beta-first prescribing precipitates crisis.
additionalDifferentials: Adenoma versus hyperplasia by vein sampling
Pheo versus essential by paroxysms and metanephrines
Conn versus renal artery by ratio and bruit
additionalInvestigations: Aldosterone renin ratio with saline suppression
